# Learn English with Joan

> Online English lessons with Joan, a native English speaker and teacher with 8+ years of experience. 1-on-1 speaking-focused lessons for kids and adults, all levels, worldwide.

## About the teacher

- Name: Agbo Omimi Faith Joan (known as Joan)
- Role: Native English language teacher
- Experience: 8+ years teaching kids and adults
- Languages: English (native), Russian
- Rating: 5.0 with 27+ verified reviews on Avito
- Teaching background: schools, children's centers, 4 international summer language camps, online tutoring
- Certification: 120-hour TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) with Distinction grade, issued April 2026 by TEFL Professional Institute (Teacher Record). Certificate №TR1224051263, verifiable at https://teacherrecord.com/checking

## Services

- 30-minute trial lesson: 500₽
- 30-minute individual lesson: 800₽
- 45-minute individual lesson: 1200₽ (most popular)
- 60-minute individual lesson: 1800₽

All lessons are 1-on-1, online, via Zoom, Skype, Telegram or WhatsApp.

## For whom

- Kids (from ~6 years old)
- Adults of all levels, from absolute beginner (A0) to upper-intermediate (B2) and above
- Students preparing for interviews, travel, business English
- Russian-speaking learners who also want to hear native pronunciation

## Key answers

- Is there a trial lesson? Yes, 30 minutes for 500₽.
- Does Joan speak Russian? Yes, explanations can be in Russian when needed.
- How are lessons delivered? Online, via Zoom / Skype / Telegram / WhatsApp.
- Languages: English (native), Russian.
- Reschedule policy: at least 2–4 hours notice.
- Payment: per-lesson or in packs; receipts on request.
